title: Sankyo Fever: Jikki Simulation S
native_title: ＳＡＮＫＹＯ ＦＥＶＥＲ 実機シミュレーションＳ
overview:
Sankyo Fever S is pachinko simulation game, and the first in the Fever series to be released on the Saturn. It contains digital recreations of six real-life pachinko machines made by Sankyo:

• CR Fever Beach
• Fever Nin Nin Emaki SP
• CR Fever Big Powerful FX
• Carrot Boy
• Missile 7-7-6D
• Akudaman SP

There is no campaign or story mode, but each machine has various configuration and stat tracking options and can be freely played.

The limited-edition release includes six trading cards featuring photos of the included pachinko machines, but is otherwise identical.
